selection: After the frozen sweep, choose the learned anchor count whose aggregate setup+solve time is closest to heuristic64, using absolute log time ratio only, independent of DFS outcomes.
confirmation: Repeat the selected learned configuration and heuristic64 on the same 55 puzzles, sequential randomized interleaving, two repetitions in a fresh directory. Use median repeated total times and report all DFS totals.
interpretation: Report actual measured times. Similar aggregate time is not an identical per-puzzle hard time limit. Do not claim exact equality when configurations differ materially in runtime.
disclosure: Top-K changes the single-anchor no-op stopping rule only when explicitly enabled. All learned variants retain 64 total contracted applications per episode and refresh rankings after useful pruning. No retraining or final test data.
other_curves: Show all tested learned K1/2/4/8 and heuristic16/32/64 values; do not pick the best node result and conceal runtime.
